An allocated-store admission invokes cleanup and then checks observed free space; unavailable DB size is informative only.
A shortfall after authorized cleanup is explicitly reported and does not return permission to begin new import writes.
Without a failed build the actual admission function honors the exact free-space boundary.
The same unlisted dangling-link fixture is installed/bootstrap-called by e7a2175 but refused before those actions by d63f1d9.
